input.quote: IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.
input.rationale: The cap is one-sided: only TrueLink's liability is limited (to 12 months' hosting/support compensation) and Client's liability — including under the broad Section 12(a) indemnity — is unlimited, which is walk-away territory. We made the 12-month cap mutual and added the standard uncapped carve-outs (confidentiality/data, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement), confirming Client's fee obligations sit outside the cap.

input.quote: TrueLink shall indemnify and hold Client harmless, its affiliates, directors, officers, employees, agents and licensors harmless from and against all claims, actions, expenses, losses, and liabilities, including reasonable attorneys' fees, arising from or relating to any
input.rationale: TrueLink's indemnity is limited to its own breach of the Agreement, with no third-party IP infringement indemnity for the Interface (and no non-infringement warranty to support one), while Client's indemnity in Section 12(a) is very broad. That fails the fallback, so we added the standard vendor indemnity for infringement, breach of law, unauthorised access to Client data and gross negligence/wilful misconduct.

input.quote: Client is not obligated to utilize the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system, design, formula, procedure or trade secret to provide software and services similar to the ones provided by TrueLink hereunder
input.rationale: No non-compete or field-of-use restriction binds Client; Section 2(a) expressly preserves our freedom to build or buy competing software and services. We note Section 8(d) cross-refers to a separate "Non-Competition Agreement" governing Credit Data use — that document should be diligenced separately, but nothing in this agreement restricts our business.

input.quote: Subject to the foregoing, Client shall order TrueLink a credit report on each borrower for which an underwriting approval is requested through a System using the Interface.
input.rationale: The licence is non-exclusive and Section 2(a) confirms we may use alternative providers, so there is no sole-supplier obligation. The only tie-in is Section 3(i), which applies solely where we choose to route an underwriting request through the Interface, is confined to a single defined product (credit reports) and runs only with the 1-year term — within the fallback; noted rather than redlined.
